text:
alex: Heads up — company tailgate for the Cup Final this Saturday at 2pm near Lot B. Who's coming? I can bring the grill if people can bring sides/drinks. :hamburger:
dina: Count me in. I'll bring veggie skewers and napkins. :seedling:
samir: If anyone has an extra parking pass that would be amazing. Lot B fills up fast.
people-ops-bot: parking: Temporary passes available. Request by replying with 'pass' or DM @people-ops.
nina: pass — DM'd people-ops. Also can someone bring sunscreen and a pop-up shade? Last year fried me. :sunglasses::sun_with_face:
chris: I have a pop-up tent + foldable chairs. Bringing cornhole set too.
alex: Amazing. Also small fantasy mini-pool: closest score prediction wins a $20 bar tab (or homemade brownies). Loser has to wear the opponent's jersey to Monday standup. :smirk:
dina: I will never wear another jersey publicly. I'm in for the bet though. brownies it is.
samir: Prediction 2-1. Also can we have a kid-friendly area? Bringing my niece for a few hours.
nina: Noted — we'll put her near the shade and snacks. Who's running music?
chris: I'll do a playlist. Throw song requests here.
alex: Quick logistics: meetup 1:30pm at lobby, share rides where possible. If you need a cooler, say so.
samir: Cooler pls. Also FYI — no glass in Lot B per signage.
dina: I can pick up non-glass drinks. Anyone allergic to nuts? I'll avoid snacks with nuts.
people-ops-bot: reminder: Please follow parking and trash rules. Tag @people-ops for permits.
chris: RSVP list so far: alex, dina, samir, nina, chris. Anyone else add yourself.
alex: Last call for shirt colors — planning to bring 10 blue bandanas for team spirit. Say if you want one.
au: (reacts with :raised_hands:)
_notes: Slack watch-party/tailgate planning thread: signups, parking-bot, accessibility/kids note, light fantasy bet, logistics. Short Slack-style messages with emoji and a bot line.
